Klasse Tuple4<A1,A2,A3,A4>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Tuple4<A1,A2,A3,A4>
Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first value
A2 - the type of the second value
A3 - the type of the third value
A4 - the type of the fourth value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Supplier<A1>, Appliable4<Tuple4.µ,A1,A2,A3,A4>, Mappable4<Tuple4.µ,A1,A2,A3,A4>, Unwindable<Tuple4<A1,A2,A3,A4>>, Value<A1>, Value2<A1,A2>, Value3<A1,A2,A3>, Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher4<Tuple4.µ,A1,A2,A3,A4>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Tuple4.µ>
public final class Tuple4<A1,A2,A3,A4> extends Object implements Appliable4<Tuple4.µ,A1,A2,A3,A4>, Mappable4<Tuple4.µ,A1,A2,A3,A4>, Unwindable<Tuple4<A1,A2,A3,A4>>, Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher4<Tuple4.µ,A1,A2,A3,A4>

An immutable, functional data structure that stores four values. This class supports functional operations such as mapping, applicative application, and lazy evaluation.

Seit:
1.0.0
